tips.text: Collect Fieldron Samples passively while playing Corpus missions and Invasions; Serro needs only 10 across both researches.
Queue Fieldron research at the Energy Lab first; Serro research cannot start until its 72-hour timer ends.
Expect a fresh solo clan to pay for the Energy Lab room itself before any research.
Nobody complains about getting Serro; the Fieldron grumbling comes from people researching the whole Energy Lab.
